description:
Fetch a backtest that already ran, by id, with the execution config it used. Use it instead of run_backtest whenever the user refers to a previous result, or to compare two runs -- re-running costs them a unit of their allowance and a stored run is the record of what actually happened.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

backtest_id.description: The run's UUID, as run_backtest returned it.

name: get_backtest
